name: Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarship
description: Merit-and-means scholarship for first-year undergraduates in any stream. Needs Class 12 marks of 60% or more and an aptitude test.
note: Official Reliance Foundation announcement and college notices confirm the portal, up to 2 lakh for UG, and the 5 Oct 2026 deadline. Income 15 lakh and 60% Class 12 marks come from Reliance text repeated by colleges and news. First-year UG only (not modelled). Confidence: high.

name: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship (CSSS)
description: Merit-cum-means scholarship for students above the 80th percentile of their Class 12 board.
note: Official FAQ confirms income 4.5 lakh and the 80th percentile rule. Percentile is NOT the same as 80%: min_academic=80 is only an approximation. Deadline unclear (renewals closed 30 Sep 2026); sample date used. Rules checked on the official FAQ. Deadline is a sample date. Confidence: high (rules).

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
description: Fee reimbursement and maintenance allowance for SC students studying after Class 10.
note: Income limit is 2.5 lakh today; the government has said it plans to raise it to 4.5 lakh. No minimum percentage was found (0 used). Deadline from secondary sources. Confidence: medium.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for ST Students
description: Support for ST students from Class 11 up to postgraduate level.
note: Income limit 2.5 lakh confirmed by the official scheme regulation and a PIB release (Dec 2025). No minimum percentage found (0 used). Deadline from secondary sources. Confidence: high (rules), medium (deadline).

name: PM YASASVI Post-Matric Scholarship (OBC/EBC/DNT)
description: Post-matric support for OBC, EBC and DNT students whose family income is up to 2.5 lakh.
note: Sources agree on the 2.5 lakh limit but give very different amounts, so amount is left as 'Varies'. Confidence: medium.

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girls
description: For girls admitted to first year (or lateral entry) of an AICTE-approved technical degree or diploma. Maximum two girls per family.
note: Many sources agree on 8 lakh, 50,000/yr and 31 Oct 2026. 'requires STEM' is an approximation of 'AICTE technical course'. First-year/lateral entry and 2-girls-per-family are not modelled. Confidence: high.

name: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Yojana (EBC)
amount: 50% to 100% of tuition and exam fees
description: Fee reimbursement for Maharashtra students of economically weaker families in professional courses admitted through CAP.
note: MahaDBT confirms income up to 8 lakh, Maharashtra domicile, 50% fees for male and 100% for female students. Deadline not found (sample date). CAP admission and the 2-children limit are not modelled. Rules checked on the MahaDBT page. Deadline is a sample date. Confidence: high (rules).

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
description: For students with 40% or more benchmark disability studying after Class 10.
note: Your old data said income 8 lakh; sources say 2.5 lakh. The disability must be 40% or more, so the profile checkbox now says so. Confidence: medium-high.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Minorities
description: For students of notified minority communities from Class 11 to postgraduate level with at least 50% marks.
note: Replaces the old 'EWS Higher Education Grant', which matched no real scheme. Income 2 lakh and 50% marks come from secondary sources. Confidence: medium.

name: Infosys Foundation STEM Stars Scholarship
description: For female undergraduates in STEM degrees at recognised colleges.
note: News reports of Infosys Foundation's press release agree on: women only, up to 1 lakh a year, family income up to 8 lakh, first-year STEM degrees (some years also second-year). No minimum marks were stated, and 2026-27 dates were not found (sample date). Official page not located. Confidence: medium.

name: Merit-cum-Means Scholarship for Minorities
description: For minority students in professional and technical courses with at least 50% marks.
note: Professional/technical course restriction is not modelled. Confidence: medium.

name: Tamil Nadu First Graduate Scheme
description: For Tamil Nadu students who are the first in their family to attend college.
note: Replaces the old 'First-Generation Learner Scholarship', which matched no national scheme. Sources disagree on whether there is an income limit. Confidence: low. Find the official tn.gov.in page.
